en.headline: Customs seizes HK$13 million of drugs from three airport passengers
en.dek: Officers at Hong Kong International Airport arrested three incoming travellers on Tuesday and seized about 25kg of suspected ketamine and 13kg of suspected cannabis buds.
body: Hong Kong Customs said it detected three separate drug trafficking cases involving incoming passengers at Hong Kong International Airport on Tuesday, seizing about 25 kilograms of suspected ketamine and about 13kg of suspected cannabis buds with a total estimated market value of about HK$13 million.

In the first case, officers found about 3kg of suspected cannabis buds, valued at about HK$700,000, in the carry-on suitcase of a 48-year-old mainland man who arrived from Bangkok on Monday night. He was arrested in the early hours of Tuesday.

A 23-year-old man from Taiwan who arrived from Barcelona was found with about 25kg of suspected ketamine, valued at about HK$10 million, in a checked-in suitcase. A 37-year-old mainland woman arriving from Bangkok via Manila was found with about 10kg of suspected cannabis buds, valued at about HK$2.3 million, in checked-in luggage.

Customs said all three were charged with trafficking in a dangerous drug and were due to appear at the West Kowloon Magistrates' Courts on Wednesday. The department said it would continue to use risk assessment to intercept high-risk passengers and urged the public not to carry items for others.

zh.headline: 海關機場破三宗旅客販毒案 檢1300萬元K仔及大麻
zh.dek: 海關周二在香港國際機場先後截獲三名入境旅客，檢獲約25公斤懸疑氯胺酮及13公斤懸疑大麻花，市值約1,300萬元。
body: 香港海關表示，周二在香港國際機場偵破三宗涉及入境旅客的販毒案件，合共檢獲約25公斤懸疑氯胺酮及約13公斤懸疑大麻花，估計市值約1,300萬元。
首宗案件中，一名48歲內地男旅客周一晚由泰國曼谷抵港，關員在其手提行李箱內檢獲約3公斤懸疑大麻花，市值約70萬元，男子於周二凌晨被捕。
第二宗案件中，一名23歲台灣男旅客由西班牙巴塞隆納抵港，關員在其寄艙行李內檢獲約25公斤懸疑氯胺酮，市值約1,000萬元。第三宗案件中，一名37歲內地女旅客經馬尼拉由曼谷抵港，寄艙行李內檢獲約10公斤懸疑大麻花，市值約230萬元。
海關表示，三人同被控販運危險藥物罪，周三在西九龍裁判法院應訊。當局會繼續以風險評估打擊高危旅客渠道，並提醒市民切勿受託攜帶來歷不明物品進出本港。
